description:
List every site on the Nekoweb account that owns the API key, with domain, title, views, followers, dates and the folder that holds each site's files. The main site is marked.

Call this first to learn the folder to use in file paths, e.g. '/mysite.nekoweb.org'.

Use nekoweb_get_site_info for a single site.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

name: nekoweb_list_sites
title: List my sites
